Decision Table 2: Battery Failure Alarm Priority
Conditions:
- battery_failure_detected

Actions:
- set_alarm_priority

| battery_failure_detected | set_alarm_priority |
|--------------------------|--------------------|
| Yes                      | High               |
| No                       | Normal             |

Decision Table 3: Sensor Reading Capability
Conditions:
- sensor_type (blower_motor, blower_power_mgm, battery_cell)

Actions:
- read_temperature

| sensor_type | read_temperature |
|-------------|------------------|
| blower_motor | Yes              |
| blower_power_mgm | Yes          |
| battery_cell | Yes              |
| other        | No               |
